sql: select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at::text, quantity, quantity_fp from position_snapshots where market_ticker in ('KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT27-NQE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT24-STOC','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT25-PEAC','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT27-PEAC') order by market_ticker, captured_at desc
